project.summary: A Shopify-backed miniature desk-setup builder where a shopper and their browser agent use WebMCP to select and arrange products, revise the scene around human choices and live constraints, and commit the reviewed setup to a real Shopify cart.
project.ai_usage: The deployed app hosts no model API. It relies on a compatible browser agent to compose Shopify native tools with five site-owned WebMCP scene tools; deterministic validation remains the source of scene truth.
project.codex_usage: OpenAI Codex supported research, product planning, architecture review, implementation, debugging, automated tests, live browser verification, deployment, evidence capture, and handoff drafting.
